sloka: अत्यन्त सुख संवृद्धः सुकुमारो हिमार्दितः ।कथम् तु अपर रात्रेषु सरयूम् अवगाहते ॥३-१६-३०॥
transliteration: atyanta sukha saṁvṛddhaḥ sukumāro himārditaḥ ।katham tu apara rātreṣu sarayūm avagāhate ॥3-16-30॥

translations.english: How can Bharata who was brought up in luxury, who is delicate, and deserves all comfort, take a dip in river Sarayu (in cold morning) ?
